name: Parsnip

schedule.notes: Use FRESH seed — viability drops fast. Keep soil moist for 3 to 4 weeks.
WAIT for several hard frosts — converts starch to sugar. Mulch heavily and pull through winter.

harvest.cues: After 2 to 3 hard freezes. Roots are 1.5 to 2 in across at the shoulder, creamy white.
harvest.storageNotes: Leave in ground under mulch through winter; harvest as needed. Or pull and store in damp sand at 32 to 40 F for months.

varieties.name: Harris Model
varieties.notes: Long, smooth, white. The reliable standard.

notes: Sap and leaves are phototoxic — wear gloves when harvesting on sunny days; the leaf juice + sun causes blisters. Always use fresh seed.
